summary_en: Marubun updated its capital cost and stock price-conscious management framework initially announced in November 2023, analyzing current progress and revising its approach for sustainable value creation.
title_en: Update on Measures to Realize Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: On November 10, 2026, Marubun Corporation announced an update to its capital cost and stock price-conscious management framework, which was first disclosed on November 7, 2023. The Board of Directors reviewed the current status and progress of the initiatives, analyzing and evaluating the implementation since the original announcement. The company released details of the updated approach through an attached document as part of its commitment to sustainable corporate value enhancement. This update reflects the company's ongoing efforts to align management decisions with both capital efficiency and shareholder value considerations.
